For ASSET-017, the broader condition context shows an attention_required state with an efficiency loss / fouling-like signature and recommends inspecting the hydraulic path [DOC-ASSET-017].

sources.title: Frame and feet (electric motor, training note)
sources.text: Frame and feet: Cast housing that holds the stator, carries heat to the cooling fins and bolts the motor to its base. Typical symptoms: Cracked or loose feet (soft foot) causing vibration; Blocked fins raising temperature. Signals: vibration_mm_s, bearing_temp_c.

Confidence is limited by low mapping confidence and data-quality issues [DQ-0029] [DQ-0105] [DQ-0119].
